title: 香蕉价格｜近似重绘
prompt: You should spend about 20 minutes on this task. The line graph shows banana prices in four countries from 1994 to 2004, in US dollars per kilogram. The points are approximate readings from a comment image associated with a candidate recall, redrawn for practice rather than presented as an official exam image. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.
